name: Margining

subjectOf.text: The regulatory challenges of blockchain based offerings should be addressed by revising federal securities law provisions to recognize digital securities, to permit broad based trading of equity-equivalent digital securities, and to permit their margining.
subjectOf.abstract: may be in part addressed by revising several federal securities law provisions to allow: (i) recognition of "digital securities," (ii) broad-based trading of equity-equivalent "digital securities," and (iii) margining of "digital securities."
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Samuel Evans, Blockchain-Based Securities Offerings (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3411110

subjectOf.text: Widespread retail investor trading of digital securities, including the ability to margin them, is the linchpin of survivability for blockchain based securities offerings; without retail access the technology may remain marginalized in the offering process.
subjectOf.abstract: will be the linchpin of survivability and evolution of blockchain-based securities offerings. Without retail investor access, the technology may remain marginalized in the offering process.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Samuel Evans, Blockchain-Based Securities Offerings (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3411110
scope_conditions: retail investor access on a widespread basis
